g.title: custody

g.title: v9
g.text: Deferred admitted real boundary in future packet

g.text: Rehash source / full cohort / configuration / supervisor

g.title: supervisor
g.text: Exactly five files before V9; rehash unchanged afterward

g.text: Closed driver logs + every raw regular member

Synthetic counts separated from real observations

g.title: later
